description: Controlled, manually maintained official event schedule for the PRE-MARKET Short. Every entry is copied from the organiser's OWN publication (never a blog, news item, search snippet or model), carries that publication's URL/reference, the exact line it was read from, when it was retrieved and when it was last verified. core.event_calendar.load_official_events() rejects (fails closed on) any entry that is incomplete, points at a non-official host, or whose dates do not match its own source line. Re-verify with: python verify_official_events.py --stamp
